caption: The drawing is vertically divided into two main sections. The upper section depicts two crowned figures: a larger seated central figure, dressed in a robe of dark blue and red with yellow accents and a veil, holding a smaller figure on her left knee. Both figures have light skin and brown hair. The larger figure has a round yellow halo behind her head, outlined with rays, while the smaller figure also has a crown and is wrapped in a light garment. The background of this section consists of an arched area filled with a pale yellow and tan color, bordered by a jagged red line. The lower section of the drawing features a symmetrical, stylized floral or foliate design dominated by bold red, black, green, and teal shapes, with curving lines and leaf-like elements filling the space. The entire drawing is outlined with a thin black border.
title: Plate 7: Our Lady of Mt. Carmel: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
